prompt: A ladder leans across two parallel deck rails, acting as a transversal. A pair of corresponding angles measure $(5x - 20)^\circ$ and $(3x + 10)^\circ$. Find $x$.
hint: Corresponding angles on parallel lines are congruent — so set the expressions EQUAL, not summed.

hints.text: Corresponding angles on parallel lines are congruent — so set the expressions EQUAL, not summed.

explanation: Because the rails are parallel, the corresponding angles are congruent: $5x - 20 = 3x + 10$.
Subtract $3x$ from both sides and add 20: $2x = 30$.
Divide by 2: $x = 15$. Check: both angles come out to $55^\circ$. ✓

alternativeExplanations.title: Check both angles
steps: They match, which is exactly what corresponding angles on parallel lines must do.
